ModMetaData.name: NJR — Not Just Raiders
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description:
Not Just Raiders (NJR) gives hostile factions more than disposable raid squads: raiders may have families and social ties, and important prisoners can become the subject of ransom negotiations, diplomatic disputes, rescue operations, and retaliation. Experimental tactics include prisoner extraction, mixed-faction operations, coordinated attacks, guarded VIP evacuation and physical construction of hostile field transport pods.
Works with RimWorld 1.7. Harmony is required. Combat Extended and War Crimes Expanded 2 integration is optional and has not been fully validated in game. This is a beta: not every raid scenario or long-term save/load path has been playtested. Make a backup of your saves before enabling the mod.
Compatibility: the historical package ID pavuk.raidshavefamilies is deliberately retained to avoid breaking existing mod lists and savegames.
[Русский] NJR — Not Just Raiders: у рейдеров есть семьи, отношения и причины действовать. Мод добавляет переговоры о пленниках, дипломатические последствия, спасательные и карательные операции. Тактика и эвакуация VIP остаются экспериментальными: не все 18 сценариев проверены в игре. Для тестирования сделайте резервную копию сохранения.
